title: Show HN: Capsule – Single-file web apps that save their data into SQLite
summary: Capsule is a Rust/Tauri 2.0 app that packages HTML apps and their data into a single SQLite file, embedding assets and supporting localStorage-style key/value storage or a MongoDB-inspired document API. It offers CSV/JSON export, sandboxed permissions, optional local or remote AI models, and UUID/timestamp-based merging for divergent copies. The file format spec is planned for 1.0.
